hero.tagline: From passive surveillance to proactive intelligence.
hero.lede: AI video and operational intelligence. Access Genie adds detection, alerting and evidence search to the cameras, recorders and record systems an organisation already runs — with nothing ripped out.

modules.title: One platform, two divisions
modules.lede: The core modules and hardware run on the cameras an organisation already has. Above them sit two divisions: Policing & public safety, and Enterprise & industry.

items.name: AI Video Analytics
items.summary: Watches live and recorded video, recognises the events an organisation defines and raises an alert with the evidence attached.

details.label: Watch every feed
details.text: Every stream is analysed around the clock, so operators review alerts instead of staring at screens.

details.label: What it can detect
details.text: Identity: face recognition, watchlist match, person search across cameras. Public order: crowd gathering, overcrowding, loitering, night movement. Threats: intrusion, restricted zones, gate jumping, unattended baggage. Stations: frisking checks, guard absence, after-hours access, camera health.

details.label: Investigator search
details.text: Face search from one reference photo, attribute search by clothing when no photo exists, a movement timeline across cameras, and watchlist alerts the moment a listed face or plate appears.

details.label: Every alert is closed
details.text: Assign, acknowledge, resolve or mark a false positive to improve tuning, then report trends by camera, zone and alert type.

details.label: Where it runs
details.text: On existing IP and PTZ cameras, on new edge AI cameras, or on a BluEdge server inside the premises.

details.label: Safeguard
details.text: Face recognition is used within the legal authorisation and procedures the organisation sets.

items.name: ANPR & vehicle intelligence
items.summary: Every vehicle that passes a camera is read, logged and checked against the rules an organisation sets, day and night.

details.label: What is captured
details.text: Number plate (reflective or not) from multiple angles, time stamp and direction of travel, and a vehicle image with every read, at speed and at night.

details.label: Checked against
details.text: Watchlists of suspect vehicles, permitted-hours rules for entry and exit, and vehicle registration records.

details.label: Rules
details.text: Watchlist hit → instant alert. Time-rule breach → ticket alert. Partly hidden, tampered or cloned plate → flag for review. Loitering, erratic movement or repeat crossings → pattern alert.

details.label: How an alert reaches the team
details.text: Plate read → rule check → ticket raised with images → SMS, email and messaging to the officers.

items.name: Video Management System
items.summary: A browser-based VMS that brings IP and analog cameras, DVRs and NVRs into one console for monitoring, recording, investigation and reporting, on-premises or in the cloud.

details.label: Unified monitoring
details.text: Video wall and custom layouts, live PTZ and digital zoom, two-way audio, a browser console for the command centre.

details.label: Recording & playback
details.text: Continuous, motion and event recording with pre- and post-event buffers, synchronised multi-camera playback, smart search, bookmarks and clip export.

details.label: Forensic search
details.text: People, vehicle and object tracking, face search from a photo, attribute search and a cross-camera timeline.

details.label: Alerts, maps & health
details.text: A central alert centre, cameras pinned on site and floor plans, and camera, recorder and storage health with scheduled reports.

details.label: Device management
details.text: ONVIF discovery and onboarding, bulk import, firmware upgrades and remote reboot. Existing recordings stay usable.

items.name: BluEdge server
items.summary: The on-premises AI server that runs Access Genie inside the organisation's premises, so sensitive data never has to leave.

details.label: Built in
details.text: Sovereign processing, zero-trust access with MFA and least privilege, encryption at rest and in transit, continuous threat detection and high availability.

details.label: What it runs
details.text: Video analytics and VMS, LLM and AI workloads, investigation platforms, dashboards and analytics, and internal communication.

details.label: Architecture
details.text: Enterprise storage chassis with room for GPU configurations, expandable high-density storage, open and Kubernetes-ready.

items.name: Field devices
items.summary: The devices that capture what Access Genie analyses, on roads, bridges and checkpoints.

details.label: Edge AI camera
details.text: 5 MP camera with AI on board for ANPR, loitering, face recognition and people counting; IR night vision to 30 m, IP66.

details.label: 4K global-shutter ANPR camera
details.text: Captures fast traffic with no motion blur across 3–4 lanes; one camera handles both ANPR and violation detection.

details.label: Pulsed IR flash & 4D radar
details.text: The flash keeps seatbelts, phones and plates readable at night; the radar measures spot and average speed, lane by lane, up to 240 km/h.

details.label: AI-VPU edge unit
details.text: Runs several violation models at the roadside with up to 1 TB local storage, sending only results over wired or 4G links.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html:
1. 01CollectStreams from IP and analog cameras, ANPR and radar, plus records, helplines and seized devices.
  2. 02DetectModels run on zones, time windows and thresholds the organisation sets — at the edge or in the cluster.
  3. 03AlertA detection becomes a prioritised alert with its evidence attached, routed to whoever owns it.
  4. 04ActThe alert lands in a workflow: a dispatch, a challan, a case, a memo, a floor-team instruction.

Built on existing cameras

IP and analog CCTV, PTZ, city and station cameras keep recording as before. Access Genie reads the streams and adds a layer on top; the recorder and the wiring stay where they are.

Processing stays where you decide

Fully on-premise, private cloud or hybrid. For most government deployments, video, records and evidence are processed and stored on infrastructure the department owns.

Connected, not another silo

Reads from and writes to the systems already in use, so officers and staff do not key the same data in twice. Each connection is scoped, tested and approved before it goes live.

Two divisions

Policing & public safety. Enterprise & industry.

One detection engine serves two divisions. For police forces, Access Genie is delivered through GARUDA, Blue Cloud's separate policing vertical, with traffic enforcement alongside it. Enterprise and industry covers retail, logistics through BluGo, and six more sectors. What changes between them is the model set, the KPIs, the workflow and who receives the alert.

sections.title: Safeguards
sections.html:
Safeguards

What it will not do, and what it always keeps.

  • Sovereign processing: AI can run on servers inside the organisation's premises.
  • Zero-trust access: identity-based, multi-factor, least privilege, micro-segmented.
  • Encryption at rest and in transit, with key management under the organisation's control.
  • Every alert carries its evidence; every action is logged for audit.
  • Face recognition only within the legal authorisation the organisation sets.
